name: Photographer

sections.daily_work: Capture and edit images for portraits, events, products, journalism, or fine art. Work with lighting, composition, and post-processing to tell visual stories.
sections.learning: Camera operation, lighting techniques, composition rules, photo editing software (Lightroom, Photoshop), business and marketing skills for freelance work.
sections.pay: Highly variable depending on specialty and freelance vs. employed status. Entry-level studio assistants may earn $25,000-$40,000 USD. Freelance rates vary widely. Always verify current data for your region.
sections.entry_routes: Photography degree or self-taught, building a portfolio, assisting established photographers, specializing in a niche (wedding, product, editorial).

try_in_real_life: Take a series of photos telling a story about your neighborhood
Learn basic photo editing with free software like GIMP or Snapseed
Practice different lighting setups using natural light
Research local photographers and ask about their workflow
sources: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics Occupational Outlook Handbook (bls.gov/ooh)
